title: Juan was a fantastic tour...
text: Juan was a fantastic tour guide - he enjoyed our walking tour of the Gothic Quarter and he introduced us to several new and delicious foods to try!
author: Karla_W

title: Wonderful walking tour of Barcelona.
text: Great walking tour of the city.  Milena was a great guide.  Very knowledgeable and passionate about the architecture of Gaudí and his contemporaries.  She also prepared us well for our visit to Sagrada Família.
author: steve_r

title: Worth it!!
text: Milena was amazing! She showed us her passion for Barcelona with every step. We had a private tour including coffee & tapas. It is a lot of walking but you’re learning as you go. Milena pointed out all the little details we would have missed. Note-Sagrada security has you take off belts & watches, be prepared.
author: WhisperLoud2874

title: I highly recommend this tour of Barcelona.
text: An incredible tour to get to know Barcelona, it is very complete, we saw many things related to the life of Gaudi and our guide Jennifer was incredible, she explained things very well to us and gave us many tips, it was great.
author: Wander49638027319

title: Beautiful Barcelona!
text: This is a walking tour, so wear good shoes!  Best way to see Barcelona.  Milena, our guide, was absolutely fabulous.  Her knowledge and information was outstanding.  Thank you Milena for a wonderful day!
author: Lauralee_G

title: The very best way to become inspired by the history arts and culture in Barcelona
text: Our guide, Valeria was outstanding what a true treasure for this experience as her passion and energy for the city and the art combined with the deep history, made this the best tour I think I have ever had utilizing Viator.
author: Deborah_K

title: Gaudi highlights
text: Great tour. Our guide was very knowledgeable and friendly. Learned a lot about Gaudi as well as the history of the area. Highly recommend
author: analeed2020

title: Worth the price!
text: Great private tour of the city for the two of us, lots of info! Loved seeing Park Guell, but very busy even on off season (still got amazing pics!). The Sagrada Familia was breathtaking, very happy we had this small group for that portion!
author: Aaron_O

title: Awesome tour of...
text: Awesome tour of Barcelona, Sagrada Família, and Park Guell. Patricia was excellent, would recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona!
author: Justin_T

title: Private City tour and Sagrada Família
text: We booked the tour via Viator , our Guide Melina was great , before we left Australia she communicated to us via WhatsApp, so I had her number to check about few things , her knowledge was great , she was friendly and suggested few restaurants after the tour to go to , we included the tickets to Sagrada Família so we had private guide inside to give us all details , this is really important as you can skip the lines and also there is a lot of information that needs to be explained . Highly recommend Melina and this tour .
author: nansig2024
